name: Akiflow
tagline: Akiflow is a productivity platform that pulls tasks from Asana, Jira, Gmail, Slack, Notion, and 10+ other tools into a single daily planner, then helps you time-block them into your calendar. Its Command Bar lets you capture and schedule tasks from anywhere with a keyboard shortcut in under two seconds. High-output professionals use Akiflow as the missing layer between their project management tools and their actual daily schedule.
